adrs.title: Prime Signature Canonical Monoid as Exclusive Rust Kernel Substrate
adrs.context: All multiplicity computations, spectral analysis, and emission decisions must share a single, deterministic representation to prevent representational drift between Lean formalization and Rust execution.
adrs.decision: The only permitted representation of a Multiplicity Signature inside the Rust kernel is a finitely supported map from primes to exponents, equipped with the free commutative monoid structure (pointwise addition of exponents). Any foreign representation must be converted at the kernel boundary and rejected if conversion is lossy

adrs.title: Axiom-Clean Kernel Boundary and Manifested Proof Debt Policy

adrs.decision: The kernel boundary (Rust + Lean interface) must be axiom-clean. Every open proof obligation that affects runtime behavior must be either (a) fully discharged or (b) explicitly manifested as a named sorry with a tracking issue and a hard CI failure if the count increases. Zero untracked proof debt is permitted on the main branch.
consequences: CI rejects any increase in manifested or unmanifested sorry count on protected paths
Kernel startup performs a static check that the formal registry and the Rust core share the same honesty manifest
Research surfaces (including F1-square) may contain open obligations only when explicitly quarantined outside the kernel boundary

adrs.title: Reinitialization — Executive Decision Brief
adrs.context: UOR technology is ahead of its operating structure: the Foundation lacks one public source of truth, an approved authority chain, coordinated release ownership, independent implementation evidence, and attributable external use. The next unit of value is confidence.
adrs.decision: Adopt the recommendation CONDITIONAL GO. Authorize a two-week Day Zero mobilization under a volunteer-only, no-funding assumption; the ninety-day baseline cycle commences only after the Secretary records the Day Zero gate complete, and until then the portfolio remains in maintenance and governance preparation. Ratify the decision set D1-D10 covering the authority chain, public source of truth, release custody, volunteer capacity, primary pilot, E0-E6 evidence policy (public claims cite evidence, date, owner, and limits), scope boundary, escalation, maintenance posture, and cycle termination. The Day Zero gate record must name at least three structured stewards. Feasibility envelope 215-400 volunteer hours across thirteen weeks (~17-31 hours/week). Ten enterprise risks (R1-R10) registered with owners and controls.
consequences: No ratification record = no baseline cycle; the condition is mechanical
Public claims bound to evidence grade, date, owner, and limits
The brief is the single ratifying artifact (D1-D10 + Day Zero gate + risk register)
Unsupported E3+ claims degrade the evidence posture on record

adrs.title: UOR Mechanics — The Exact Math of Prime-Indexing
adrs.context: Mutable file-path identity permits duplication, reordering, and platform-dependent drift; UOR requires collision-free, compositionally rich, exactly reproducible identity across heterogeneous nodes.
adrs.decision: Adopt prime-indexing as the canonical UOR substrate. Irreducible identity: a prime is the invariant identity of a node; composites encode relations. Exponents as memory (OFA-ii): k_i in n = product p_i^k_i is a surplus ledger; primes accumulate monotonically (p to p^2 to p^3). Lawful composition: K1 ⊗ K2 = lcm(K1, K2) as a lossless structural join preventing duplication. Multiplicative union: K1 ⊕ K2 = product over p of p^(v_p(K1) + v_p(K2)). Zero-drift architecture: exact rational arithmetic only, no floating point. Cryptographic verification: Binary Canonical Serialization (fixed field orders, ULEB128 prefixes) and Poseidon2 ZK sealing (t=9, r=8). Call-market cleavage (Holotrade, phase-gated): Fee = 1/10 * DeltaP; node yield = ask + 9/10 * DeltaP, with receipt-locked ledger finality.
consequences: State is never identified by mutable path; one prime-indexed ledger drives identity, history, and compensation
Merges are lossless and deduplicating (lcm); unions are exact (exponent addition)
BCS + Poseidon2 sealing make receipts tamper-evident and cross-platform (Rust/Lean)
Banned floats foreclose drift and penny-shaving settlement attacks
Implemented substrate: ADR-0013 canonical BCS wire format and PWEH integrity chain
